description:
From 2025-04-30 (when the compromised intermediates were issued) until 2026-10-21/23, several clients on the maintainer's Mac trusted the compromised eMudhra emSign intermediates without enforcing Certificate Transparency: `/usr/bin/git` and `/usr/bin/curl` (via `/etc/ssl/cert.pem`), Python environments with certifi older than 2026.10.18, grpcio's bundled roots, Node, Bun- and Deno-based CLIs, and the awscli and gcloud bundles. No TLS logs exist, so interception can be neither shown nor ruled out, and no indicator of compromise was found.

Rotate, in this order, and review each provider's audit log for the window:
1. GitHub credential used by git over HTTPS (keychain) - GitHub security log.
2. Databricks personal access token - Databricks audit logs.
3. Snowflake password - LOGIN_HISTORY.
4. Claude Code OAuth, omp provider tokens, npm token, Gemini, Meta, gcloud user credentials, Turso/todo-db tokens (upgrade each client first).
5. Precautionary: AWS access keys (SigV4 never sends the secret), the GCP service-account key (only short-lived access tokens were sent), OpenAI and Cerebras API keys - CloudTrail and GCP audit logs.
